resources.string: Authentication where a breach exposes nothing.

Your biometric never leaves this device. ZeroAuth derives a one-way commitment on the device and only the commitment is anchored on the audit chain. Even the operator cannot reverse it to your face or fingerprint.
Enrollment will land in the next iteration.
Point at the QR on your laptop
ZeroAuth uses the camera only to read the desktop login QR. Nothing is recorded.
That QR did not match the ZeroAuth desktop-login format. Refresh the laptop and try again.
This will release a one-shot proof to %1$s. The proof reveals no biometric data — only that you are the enrolled user.
Confirm with your fingerprint or face
~5 seconds. Don\'t switch apps while we work.
Show this to the laptop\'s webcam
Hold your phone up to the desktop\'s camera. The desktop will sign you in automatically.
In the next iteration this screen will generate the Groth16 proof and complete the handshake. For now it confirms the QR decoded cleanly.
